title: Shannon Entropy
statement: Implement `entropy(labels)`, the Shannon entropy in bits of the empirical label distribution. Use log base 2. Skip classes that do not appear. A pure list has entropy 0. A fair coin of two labels has entropy 1.

hints: Add −p log2(p) for each class that appears.
Do not include a zero-count class; the limit of p log p is 0 but log(0) is undefined.

approaches.name: Empirical entropy
approaches.explanation: ID3 and C4.5 split on information gain, which is the drop in this entropy.

editorial: Shannon entropy H = − Σ pₖ log₂ pₖ measures surprise in bits. Decision-tree information gain is the entropy of the parent minus the weighted entropy of the children. Only observed classes contribute; a missing class has probability 0 and adds nothing. Natural log gives nats instead of bits. State the base. A balanced two-class node is exactly 1 bit.
